Based on my careful analysis of the image, here are the precise answers to your questions:

**1. Is this showing a HEADER or individual PROGRAM CARDS?**
This is showing **individual PROGRAM CARDS** (specifically, a list of program items/rows). The top section with the orange calendar icon is the page header ("Program & Kegiatan"), but the annotated area shows individual program entry cards below the statistics boxes.

**2. FIRST card (top) details:**
*   **Title text exactly:** `Program Kerja Nasional & Daerah — DPD Kalimantan Barat`
*   **Buttons on the right side:**
    1.  `Upload PDF` (with upload icon)
    2.  `Tambah Program` (blue button with plus icon)

**3. SECOND card (bottom) - What changed?**
*   **What was added:** A new button/link labeled **"Dokumen Program Kerja"** with a document icon (looks like a file/page icon).
*   **Where exactly:** It was added on the **left side of the title**, immediately **before** the title text begins.
*   **Format:** It is an **icon + text** combination (icon first, then text).

**4. Annotation text/arrow:**
*   **Text:** "lihat dokmen program kerja , yg saya minta belom ada" (translation: "see program work document, which I requested is not yet there")
*   **Pointing to:** It points specifically to the newly added **"Dokumen Program Kerja"** button on the second card.

**5. Right side buttons comparison:**
The buttons appear to be **the same structure**, though only partially visible on the second card:
*   **Card 1:** `Upload PDF` | `Tambah Program`
*   **Card 2:** [Edit/Pencil icon] | [Delete/Trash icon] *(Note: These appear to be action buttons for that specific row, whereas Card 1 shows global actions)*

**6. '30 program' badge location:**
*   **Yes**, there is a "30 program" badge.
*   It appears in the **FIRST card (top)** only, positioned immediately after the title text "Program Kerja Nasional & Daerah — DPD Kalimantan Barat".

**7. Position of the new icon/button:**
The correct answer is **(b) Right after any left-side icons but before the title text starts** — or more precisely, it sits at the **far left of the content area**, before the title text begins.
*(Technically, it's positioned at the start of the line, before the title text, making it the leftmost element in that row's content area).*

**8. OVERALL layout structure (Left to Right):**

**First Card (Top):**
```
[Icon] [Title Text: Program Kerja Nasional & Daerah — DPD Kalimantan Barat] [Badge: 30 program] ................... [Upload PDF] [Tambah Program]
```

**Second Card (Bottom):**
```
[NEW: Dokumen Program Kerja Button] [Title Text: Tujuan, strategi, dan arah kebijakan program kerja...] .......................................... [Edit Icon] [Delete Icon]
```

**Summary for implementation:**
You need to add a **"Dokumen Program Kerja"** button (with document icon) at the **beginning of each program card row**, **before** the title text. This should appear as the leftmost element in the card's content area, to the left of where the program title is displayed.
